generated.details: On the middle-right tabletop beside the printer, the plain charcoal cutting mat is a thin rectangular rubber sheet with flat corners and no grid, numbers or lettering.
Several unlabelled cream, taupe and gray fabric swatches overlap on the mat, with woven surfaces, softly frayed cut edges and slight curls.
Farther back at right, the studio task lamp has a weighted base, two hinged metal arms and a downward-facing shade, all clear of the printer.
